title: Kiritani Haruka — Happy Birthday! 2023〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: The weekend
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Seems like everyone's here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Off to the venue we go♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? But aren't Hoshino and the others coming today as well?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. We forgot to tell you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ichika and the others will be waiting for us at the venue. So we'll be the ones guiding you over there♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, really? But what do you all mean by “venue”...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, you will understand when we arrive. Anyway, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Love the confidence, but that's the opposite direction!
A few minutes later
Penguin Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We have arrived! Make yourself comfortable, Haruka♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? This is...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, they're here! The star of the day is here!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There's a seat we had specifically prepared for you. Please sit.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A seat specifically for me? Are you...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Talking about this penguin-shaped sofa?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Apparently the cafe just got this sofa recently.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The penguin is so cute with its flippers wide open, like it's saying, “Please, come sit!” We thought that you'd really like it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I-I really do. It's so adorable!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But, is it really okay for me to sit on it? Emperor penguins are one of the larger kinds of penguin, but even so, I'd feel bad if it were to be crushed under my weight...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's what you're worried about?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, I didn't know that this sofa was an emperor penguin.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's amazing that you can tell just from looking, Haruka. I guess you don't just love penguins, but you also know a lot about them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, if you say you're heavy then we're all heavy too! Besides, it says down here that this sofa can take up about 100 kilograms!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see, so it's quite sturdy. In that case, don't mind if I do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-oh my gosh... Haruka is sitting on a penguin-shaped sofa...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A cute person sitting on top of a cute sofa is blinding my eyes! May I request permission to take a photo?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Looks like we have more than one person in the room getting excited...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. They certainly seem to be enjoying themselves.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: By the way, it's almost time for that “thing” we ordered to come, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, yes it is. I think it'll be here soon...

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Thank you for your patience. Here is the special penguin cake!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's amazing, right, Haruka? It's an ultra super duper wonderhoy cake!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I-It's...an erect-crested penguin saying happy birthday to me...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So this is called an erect-crested penguin, huh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I-I have to make this my background!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm so glad you like it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This cake is so cute that I think not only Kiritani, but anyone would have a hard time eating it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Y-Yes, it is a little difficult, but...it would be a shame to not share and enjoy it with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Though, how should we go about dividing it all up?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: First things first, let's give Haruka all of the penguin cake decorations!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? Is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course! All of these cute penguins just can't wait to go over to you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “Happy birthday, Haruka honk! I hope you have an amazing day honk♪”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Aww, your penguin imitation is so cute, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? Really?!
Oh, you're making me blush!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Penguins go honk?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, I guess in Saki's imagination, they do?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it's so cute! Also...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, everyone.
I'm so...just so happy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm happy that you're happy, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, it's way too early to thank us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We still have so much more penguin-filled goodness for you in store!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Penguin-filled goodness?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's right! I also thought up a lot of stuff just for you, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We hope you have a great time until the very end!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is this recording? I'm glad that I was able to celebrate your birthday today with you, Kiritani. Once again, happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
“Happy birthday honk!”
Just kidding! I hope you enjoyed the penguin-filled birthday party, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, I hope so too. But still, I was surprised to find out you knew so much about penguins, Kiritani. You don't only have love for penguins, but also so much knowledge about them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup! You knew just from looking at the sofa and the cake! That's so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You looked like you really enjoyed it, so let's all go again together sometime. Have a wonderful birthday, Kiritani. Looking forward to making more memories.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hello, are you all able to hear me? This is Minori Hanasato, the first member of the “Make Haruka Kiritani's Birthday a National Public Holiday” committee!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I really do hope this never becomes an official committee... But in terms of celebrating your birthday, Haruka, I feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad that I was able to see you smile a lot today, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Me too!
Your face when you were in front of those penguins... Hehehe, I just know your fans will be surprised at how different from normal you are!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But after seeing all of those cute penguins today, I couldn't help but want to know more about them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, then how about we all go to the aquarium together sometime?! And Haruka can be our penguin expert!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That sounds lovely. I think we'd learn so much if Haruka was the one to guide us around.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: On top of doing a pre-celebration, I guess we'll be doing a post-celebration too. But, that'll be fun. I think Haruka would really like that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay! No matter how many times we celebrate Haruka's birthday, it always makes me so happy!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay then, I'll send you all a message once I've sorted out all of the details. I hope you look forward to it too, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Going to the penguin cafe was fun as always, but... I really feel like I have the most fun when everyone is there with me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course, I felt the same at the pre-celebration in SEKAI and during the livestream too. Receiving all of those wonderful birthday wishes from my fans...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Makes me so appreciative. It truly feels like I have so many people's support behind me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why I better give just as much back to each and every one of them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Actually, no. I will work hard to deliver even more hope than that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I hope you will continue to give me your support.
